title: FlatMap Service State
description: Applies an expression to each item in an array and concatenates all results into a single flat array. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/flat-map)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

expression.description: Expression evaluated per input item. Should return an array or a value. Uses the same expression syntax and built-in functions as the [Map](./map.md) service.
